03 — Who We Are

Built From Site Experience

Vencore is a self-performing structural concrete contractor. Our supervisors, nozzlemen, steel fixers and finishers work under one roof, providing specialised shotcrete and steel-fixing services across Melbourne and Victoria.

We work directly with builders, subcontractors, developers and project managers to deliver safe, practical and efficient outcomes on site — keeping quality, safety and program in our hands.
